text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on April 25, 26 and 27 2018. April 25, 2018 Mayor Tory, during the morning session of the meeting, advised Members of Council that the City of Toronto has established the Toronto Strong Fund in partnership with the Toronto Foundation to assist victims of the tragic event that took place in Toronto on Monday, April 23, 2018 and to provide donations to community organizations including Victims Services Toronto, which has been mandated to provide crisis support to witnesses or other people who were affected directly or indirectly by the tragedy. The Mayor advised that more information is available at www.torontofoundation.ca/torontostrong .
